paper_title: Systematic comparison of sequencing-based spatial transcriptomic methods
data_availability: Raw count matrices are available at the National Genome Data Center (https://www.cncb.ac.cn/) under BioProject accession code PRJCA020621. The cadasSTre data collections are continually updated on our website genographix.com. The standard sectioning protocol is deposited in protocols.io: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5qpvo379dv4o/v1.
code_availability: Scripts used to process the data are available at https://github.com/YOU-k/cadasSTre.
